an4.230:1.1: assaddho hoti dussīlo hoti kusīto hoti duppañño hoti …pe… saddho hoti sīlavā hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti
an4.230:1.2: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti.
